verdict.rationale: Runpod documents connecting to Pods through a web proxy for exposed web services, which covers serving applications from an instance. Instant Clusters describe multi-node compute with high-performance networking, but nothing explicitly documents private networking between ordinary instances. Community remarks about a locked-down environment concern tunneling tools, not port exposure, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit port-configuration docs (HTTP/TCP port mapping), documented private networking between standalone Pods, independent or hands-on corroboration.
